rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=False, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-8: ONE knob -> warm_start true -> false (per-image fit starts from a FIXED fresh U-Net init, NO amortized GT-free pre-pass). Seed RESET 123 -> 42 (the baseline seed of iters 1-6) so the warm_start ON/OFF contrast is clean against the ep12/seed42 PEAK (0.5081), not confounded by the seed-123 basin. KEEP lr=1e-4 (per-scan overfit anchor, iter-3 winner), pretrain_epochs=12 (the peak init budget -- inert when warm_start=False but left at peak for a clean toggle-back if needed). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): the iter-7 seed probe's FALSIFIER FIRED. Trend ep12/lr1e-4: seed42 SSIM 0.5081 PSNR 16.376 (iter-5 PEAK); seed42/ep18 0.5016 PSNR 16.29 (iter-6); seed123/ep12 0.4203 PSNR 13.085 (iter-7). Flipping ONLY the seed dropped SSIM 0.5081 -> 0.4203 (-0.088) and PSNR 16.38 -> 13.09 dB (-3.3 dB) -- far outside the iter-7 falsifier band (predicted +/-0.01, threshold <0.49). So ~0.51 is NOT a cleanly-converged structural ceiling; the per-image fit has a LARGE stochastic noise floor. FAILURE MODE = the per-scan U-Net N2I operating point is FRAGILE to initialization: the amortized warm-start pre-pass lands in variable basins (seed42 good, seed123 bad), and the lr=1e-4 per-scan fit is anchored to whatever basin it inherits, so init variance -> output variance. n_iter is RULED OUT (iter-2 1200 steps REGRESSED 0.4785->0.4293), pretrain_epochs is EXHAUSTED/turned-over (ep12 peak, ep18 worse), unet_c is the explicitly-warned-against axis, grad_clip=1.0 is LOAD-BEARING (128-view FBP adjoint guard, mandatory -- do NOT touch). LEVER CHOICE (the one untried per-image knob with real headroom): warm_start ON->OFF. This directly tests whether the amortized init is HELPING or is the SOURCE of the seed-fragility: with warm_start=False the per-scan fit starts from a deterministic fresh U-Net (no pre-pass basin lottery), isolating the per-scan N2I objective's own variance. WARM-START-FRAGILITY HYPOTHESIS: the 0.5081->0.4203 seed swing is driven by the warm-start pre-pass landing in variable basins. (a) If warm_start=False SSIM stabilizes near/above ~0.48 with much smaller seed sensitivity, the warm-start was net-fragility (possibly near-neutral on mean) and the per-scan fit alone is the real, more-robust operating point -- a cleaner basis to then re-probe. (b) If SSIM COLLAPSES well below 0.42, the warm-start init was load-bearing POSITIVE and the seed swing is intrinsic to the per-scan N2I objective on this 128-view synthetic substrate -- which CONFIRMS (with the bilateral twin's hr+0.33 at 6 params that physically cannot overfit) that an over-parameterized U-Net is the wrong tool here, documenting the structural ceiling for iter-20. Either branch is informative toward the iter-20 mandate. hr expected ~0 (structurally FBP-bounded on dense-view phantoms). WALL: warm_start=False ELIMINATES the 12x200=2400-step pre-pass, leaving ONLY per-image 6x600=3600 steps @ ~0.083 s/step ~= 300 s (iter-7 was 544 s WITH the pre-pass), comfortably under the 15-min target, the outer_wall_s=1200 guard, and the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall -- no need to drop val_n/n_iter. All other knobs IDENTICAL to the iter-5 PEAK config (train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, pretrain_epochs=12, n_iter=600, lr=1e-4, unet_c=16); ONLY warm_start true->false (and seed reset 123->42 to anchor the ON/OFF comparison).
